comment: PR-07 segment 7: the read path of the accessibility backend (ui.snapshot / ui.node). Expectations come from an independent reading of upstream A11yBackend.snapshot/collect/screenData and NodeActions.readNode/describe/findByIdPreorder; the legacy JVM tests cannot build AccessibilityNodeInfo, so every case here is C#-only and the live legacy Relay is compared byte for byte on the device (automation.relay-a11y-read). Trees: b=[left,top,right,bottom] as getBoundsInScreen reports it, null children are what getChild returned, flags are the boolean getters, actions are actionList ids, range.min/max/current are the float values (javaX is how Float.toString prints them). data is the exact JSONObject.toString text.
